notes.title: Patch note 0.5.0
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[b]Bot and Tic[/b]

[list]
[*] Added a save system to make it easier to navigate after reaching certain checkpoints.
[*] Added a hint system that appears after some time in levels to better guide players.
[*] Optimized the session creation system (no more issues where you had to close the game to create or join a session).
[*] Improved FPS in level 2 and fixed a crash when the fireworks effect played too many times.
[*] Added a UI for displaying tips.
[*] Minor gameplay fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: V 0.4.0 early access
notes.content:
Bot & Tic - Patch Notes v0.4.0

Hello Explorers!

We're excited to bring you version 0.4.0 of Bot & Tic with several key improvements and fixes to enhance your gameplay experience. Here’s what’s new:

🔧 Optimizations

Significant performance improvements for smoother gameplay on all configurations.

🌍 UI & Localization Overhaul

The entire user interface has been redesigned for better readability and usability.

Full revision of translations to ensure clarity and consistency across languages.

🐞 Bug Fixes

Fixed multiple bugs affecting the tutorial and its visual elements.

Various minor bugs have been resolved to improve overall stability.

🎮 Gameplay Enhancements

Tweaks and improvements to core gameplay mechanics for a more engaging experience.

Thank you for your continued support! More updates are on the way as we move closer to release.

notes.title: Update 0.3.5 – New Grab System, Translations & Tutorial!

• Added \[b]subtitles and translations\[/b] for the following languages: \[i]French, Spanish, German, Italian\[/i].

• \[b]Post-process system reworked\[/b] entirely: lighting tone, effects and visual clarity improved.[/p][p][/p][p]\[b]\[u]🔧 Optimizations & Visual Improvements\[/u]\[/b]
• \[b]Performance optimizations\[/b] in several areas (lighting, interaction code, mesh culling).

• \[b]Light setup optimized\[/b] to reduce visual noise and improve contrast.[/p][p][/p][p]\[b]\[u]🧩 Gameplay Tweaks\[/u]\[/b]

• Added \[b]language selector\[/b] to the settings menu.[/p][p][/p][p]\[i]Thanks again for playing Bot & Tic! This update brings us closer to a polished full version!\[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491564/a2b109f0582ea466d22d5835e2dda1c852593bfc.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: [Coming Soon] Patch 0.1.1 – New Languages, Improvements & Optimizations
notes.content:
[p]\[b]\[u]🚧 Coming Soon – Patch 0.1.1 with New Languages, Improvements and Optimizations!\[/u]\[/b][/p][p]Hey everyone! 👋
Patch \[b]0.1.1\[/b] is coming soon to \[b]Bot & Tic\[/b], and we’re excited to share what's on the way. This update focuses on accessibility, smoother gameplay and technical enhancements to make your co-op experience even better![/p][p][/p][p]\[b]\[u]🌍 New Languages\[/u]\[/b]
We're adding full support (UI + subtitles) for:
• 🇫🇷 \[b]French\[/b]
• 🇮🇹 \[b]Italian\[/b]
• 🇰🇷 \[b]Korean\[/b]
• 🇪🇸 \[b]Spanish\[/b]
• 🇩🇪 \[b]German\[/b][/p][p][/p][p]\[b]\[u]🛠 Quality of Life – Grab System Overhaul\[/u]\[/b]
The object grabbing system has been reworked to be:
• More intuitive
• Less random
• Smoother in co-op situations
\[i]No more frustration – just precision and flow!\[/i][/p][p][/p][p]\[b]\[u]🎨 Visual & Graphic Optimizations\[/u]\[/b]
• Better performance
• Improved lights and shadows
• More immersive visual experience[/p][p][/p][p]\[b]\[u]🌐 Network Connection Improvements\[/u]\[/b]
• More stable session creation and joining
• Fewer desync and connection issues[/p][p][/p][p]\[b]Stay tuned – Patch 0.1.1 is on its way very soon!\[/b]
Thanks again for your amazing support.
\[i]— The Twinties Studio Team\[/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491564/dea096830a04e0c98b98ddb61a34b46789de0291.png"][/img][/p]
